Stationary rail receiver.purpose: Locate and support the removable cap.
Stationary rail receiver.rationale: Two top-access fasteners capture the cartridge against the installed axial seats.
Stationary rail receiver.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

Removable cap and ears.purpose: Locate the motor pilot and fasten the motor at the bench.
Removable cap and ears.rationale: The assembled bearing block obstructs both rear motor-screw driver paths.
Removable cap and ears.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

Spindle.purpose: Transmit drive torque into the screw.
Spindle.rationale: The face keeps the motor and screw shaft ends separated.
Spindle.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M3 on cap 0.purpose: Fasten the motor to the removable cap.
M3 on cap 0.rationale: These fasteners stay installed during cartridge removal.
M3 on cap 0.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M3 on cap 1.purpose: Fasten the motor to the removable cap.
M3 on cap 1.rationale: These fasteners stay installed during cartridge removal.
M3 on cap 1.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M4 cap retention 0.purpose: Retain the cartridge on its locating rails.
M4 cap retention 0.rationale: Both screws must be removed before axial withdrawal.
M4 cap retention 0.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M4 cap retention 1.purpose: Retain the cartridge on its locating rails.
M4 cap retention 1.rationale: Both screws must be removed before axial withdrawal.
M4 cap retention 1.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M4 receiver attachment 0.purpose: Attach the stationary receiver to the prepared bearing block.
M4 receiver attachment 0.rationale: Installing these first leaves clear straight driver paths.
M4 receiver attachment 0.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M4 receiver attachment 1.purpose: Attach the stationary receiver to the prepared bearing block.
M4 receiver attachment 1.rationale: Installing these first leaves clear straight driver paths.
M4 receiver attachment 1.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

Slide drive motor.purpose: Drive the slide screw in both directions.
Slide drive motor.rationale: The purchase-bound motor fits the cap at the calculated loaded voltage.
Slide drive motor.basis: Lightweight motor envelope from the purchased STEP, including its pilot, shaft, 35 mm case and all four measured wire-end faces. Full purchased BRep was used in the service check.

Slide bearing mount 220.purpose: Support the screw and attach the motor receiver to the chassis.
Slide bearing mount 220.rationale: Two offset pilots leave room for the spinning clamp and lie in solid stock.
Slide bearing mount 220.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

Double pinch hub.purpose: Couple the screw spindle to the round motor shaft.
Double pinch hub.rationale: Separate pinches can be loosened with the cartridge still in the robot.
Double pinch hub.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M2.5 pinch spindle.purpose: Clamp the hub to its shaft.
M2.5 pinch spindle.rationale: At the indexed maintenance position a straight driver reaches this screw.
M2.5 pinch spindle.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.

M2.5 pinch motor.purpose: Clamp the hub to its shaft.
M2.5 pinch motor.rationale: At the indexed maintenance position a straight driver reaches this screw.
M2.5 pinch motor.basis: Preliminary package derived from the service trial, 1:1 in millimeters. Connector mating hardware and clamp preload require measured confirmation.
